# SuperWeb

> A WebMCP demonstration on the fictional Kestrel Supply Co. The page registers
> its own tools, so an agent operates the real product through the same code
> path a click takes. This file describes the site for an agent reading it from
> outside. An agent already on the page does not need it: the tool list arrives
> through `navigator.modelContext`.

The application is a client-rendered single page at
https://webmcp-superweb.vercel.app. Fetching that URL returns an empty shell,
because the catalogue, the dashboard and the tool surface are all built in the
browser. There are no sub-pages to crawl and no public JSON API to read: the
endpoints under `/api/` are read-only and exist for the page, not for callers.

## Two surfaces, one origin

The **public surface** is a trade catalogue of 28 photographed products. Its
tools search and filter the real catalogue, open and compare products, manage a
cart and wishlist, file trade enquiries, switch between five locales, and read
Kestrel's authored profile for a product family. One of them is registered by
the browser from HTML rather than by JavaScript: the search form carries
`toolname` and `tooldescription`, so Chrome synthesises its schema from the
markup.

The **internal surface** is a dashboard over a DuckDB pipeline. Its tools answer
metric questions, break any metric along any dimension, check whether a given
slice is trustworthy, draft a multi-section report, and trace a number back to
the system it came from.

The tool set follows page state, never identity. Report tools appear when the
report opens, diagnostic tools appear once a check has failed, and a product's
preview recipe appears only while that product is open. Because that set is
built at registration time from live data, the names and the schema enums live
in the code rather than in this file. `src/mcp/README.md` is the current list.

## Signing in is not a tool

The internal surface appears only after a person signs in on the page, and no
registered tool can sign in. An agent that could call it would grant itself the
second tool set, which would make the swap something the page does to itself
rather than something a person does. An agent that reads this file and then
finds the smaller tool set is looking at the signed-out catalogue, and that is
the whole reason.

The demo session is identity, not security. The cookie decides how deep an
answer goes, never whether a question may be asked, so a missing session costs
detail rather than access.

## What the site refuses to do

November 2023 is missing a month of euro exchange rates, so 7,831 of 31,084
order lines fell out of the pipeline. Four countries lose every line. The Online
channel keeps a figure that looks ordinary and is roughly a quarter short. The
report tools read the pipeline's own quality checks and refuse a section rather
than publish a figure that survived a failed check, and a blocked section omits
the figure key entirely rather than sending zero. Exporting a drafted report
needs a person to press Approve on the page.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/README.md): what the application is, the full tool tables, and what the probes found in Chrome's implementation
- [Tool reference and recipe](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/src/mcp/README.md): how a tool is written here, the group gates, and the annotation rules
- [CONTEXT.md](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/CONTEXT.md): the glossary, what each word means in this project and which near-synonyms it beats
- [SUBMISSION.md](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/SUBMISSION.md): the challenge write-up, the problem and why it needs WebMCP rather than a hosted MCP server
- [ETL and data](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/etl/README.md): the bronze to silver to gold pipeline and the quality checks the trust tools read

## Decisions

- [ADR 0001](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-keep-the-etl-real.md): keep the ETL real rather than replacing it with fixtures
- [ADR 0002](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-trust-verdict-has-three-values.md): a trust verdict has three values and ranges over metric, period and filter
- [ADR 0003](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/docs/adr/0003-the-fx-gap-is-planted.md): the FX gap is planted in bronze, not found and not faked
- [ADR 0004](https://github.com/HuyDoan-2112/webmcp-superweb/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-the-declarative-tool-answers-with-a-count.md): the declarative tool answers with a count, not with products
